parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to cluster, which indicates E-HPC clusters.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The resource tags. You can specify up to 20 tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag key cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. The tag value cannot be an empty string. It can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`.
